Where we fly you

Destinations we know like home

Because for our passengers, most of them are home. Flights, hotels and full vacation packages — on almost every airline, to almost anywhere in the world.

Trinidad

Maracas Bay and bake-and-shark, Carnival season, family in Port of Spain — the route Travelspan was built on.

Tobago

Pigeon Point's jetty, Buccoo Reef and the oldest protected rainforest in the western hemisphere — Trinidad's quieter sister isle.

Guyana — Georgetown

Stabroek Market, the seawall, and family waiting at the airport. Our Guyana office (TravelSpan GT) is there if plans change mid-trip.

Guyana — Kaieteur Falls

The world's largest single-drop waterfall, deep in the rainforest. Ask us about adding a Kaieteur day trip to your Guyana visit.

Why Travelspan

An airline counter could never do this

Online booking sites sell you a seat. Travelspan has spent 30+ years looking after the whole trip — and the people waiting at the other end of it.

Our own charter flights from JFK

For years Travelspan has contracted a dedicated Boeing 757-200 — 200 seats for our customers between the Caribbean and the USA, departing JFK Terminal 1, with hot meals, movies, drinks and an in-flight coordinator on board. Convenient departure times and low fares, personalized the way only a charter can be.

Real offices on both ends

Our GSA partners — TravelSpan GT and Amral's Travel — represent us in Trinidad and Guyana. Need to change a flight or sort out an issue mid-trip? There's a Travelspan office near your destination, not a call center.

Groups, handled end to end

Family reunions, church trips, weddings, school and sports groups — one call coordinates everyone's flights, hotels and transfers, with payment plans that let the whole group save together.

Protected, start to finish

Add travel insurance to any booking, and get honest advice from a management team with over 50 years of combined travel-industry experience — before you pay a cent.
